LightningComponentBundle.description: Unit's payment plans with computed per-unit amounts (pre/post-handover). Flow outputs: selectedPlanId, selectedPriceListItemId, computedNetPrice (text), chosenAction (PayEOI|ReserveDirect).

property.name: unitId
property.label: Unit (Inventory) Id
property.description: Id of the Inventory__c unit whose payment plans to show.

property.name: preselectedPlanId
property.label: Pre-selected Payment Plan Id
property.description: Optional. Opens with this plan already chosen (e.g. the plan on the EOI), if it is still offered for the unit.

property.name: requirePlanSelection
property.label: Require a plan to be selected
property.description: When checked, the user cannot press Next/Finish until a payment plan is selected.

property.name: computedNetPrice
property.label: Computed Net Price (text)
property.description: Effective price of the selected plan as text; convert in the flow with VALUE().

property.name: chosenAction
property.label: Chosen Action
property.description: 'PayEOI' or 'ReserveDirect' — set when the user presses an action button.
